Container.Name: undocked-launcher
Container.Overview: Undocked Launcher is a self-hosted homelab dashboard for Unraid. It auto-discovers all running Docker containers and presents them as a clean, dark-themed grid with one-tap access via three methods: direct IP:port (green), Tailscale (purple), and Cloudflare Tunnel (orange). Features: - Auto-discovery via Docker socket - FolderView Plus grouping — mirrors your existing Unraid Docker folder layout - Tailscale hostname auto-detection from the Unraid Docker manager - Cloudflare Tunnel URL support using the same hostname as Tailscale - Light and dark theme toggle - Mobile-friendly responsive layout - Custom app entries for non-Docker services - Configurable icon size, text size, button size, and card width

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Host port to access the Undocked Launcher web interface. Container listens on 3000 internally.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Docker socket — required for container auto-discovery. Must be read-only.

Config.Name: Config Storage
Config.Description: Stores your settings: host IP, Cloudflare domain, Tailscale tailnet, display preferences, and custom apps.

Config.Name: Unraid Docker Templates
Config.Description: Used to auto-detect the Tailscale hostname set for each container in the Unraid Docker manager. Optional but recommended.

Config.Name: FolderView Plus Config
Config.Description: Used to group containers using your existing FolderView Plus folder assignments. Requires the FolderView Plus Unraid plugin.
